recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中箭頭指出數顆組織球（histiocytes），細胞較大、細胞質豐富且呈淡藍灰色，內含細顆粒狀碎屑與小空泡，核呈腎形或卵圓偏心，與周圍的顆粒球前驅細胞及脂肪空泡並存。
features: Several histiocytes (arrows) larger than surrounding myeloid cells
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Cytoplasm containing fine granular debris and small vacuoles
Oval to reniform eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors, erythroid cells and large fat vacuoles
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors with large fat vacuoles. Several histiocytes (arrows) are identified, characterized by abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with indistinct borders, fine granular debris and small vacuoles, and oval to reniform eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin. No hemophagocytosis of intact red cells or leukocytes, organisms, or storage-type cytoplasm is evident. Findings are consistent with normal marrow histiocytes (macrophages).

ddx.vs: Monocytes are smaller with folded nuclei and gray cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, lacking the phagocytosed debris of tissue histiocytes.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes contain engulfed intact red cells, platelets or nucleated cells, which are not seen here.
Storage histiocytes have fibrillary tissue-paper cytoplasm or distinct deep blue granules rather than scant granular debris.
Mast cells are packed with dense purple metachromatic granules obscuring a round central nucleus.
